title: 馬克白 1-1 荒野女巫
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, dark fantasy atmosphere
characters: witch one has a single eye, witch two has a torn grinning mouth, witch three has pale white pupils, all in tattered cloaks with faces mostly in shadow

panels.prompt: wide establishing shot, desolate Scottish moor at dusk, storm clouds, a single lightning bolt splitting the sky, no characters
medium shot of a twisted dead tree and scattered rocks on a windswept moor, grass bent flat by violent wind, no characters
narrow cinematic panel, three blurred dark silhouettes emerging from thick fog, only outlines visible, no faces
three witches revealed facing forward, {characters}, standing on a stormy moor

dialogue.speaker: 女巫甲
dialogue.text: 我們三個何時再相會？在雷聲、閃電，還是雨中？

panels.prompt: close-up of the second witch, a torn grinning mouth splitting her shadowed face

dialogue.speaker: 女巫乙
dialogue.text: 等這場混亂平息，等那場仗打完——有人贏，有人輸。

top-down bird's eye view of three cloaked witches standing in a circle on dark moorland
a withered bony hand of a witch pointing into deep fog
three witches turning their heads simultaneously to stare directly at the viewer, {characters}, six glowing eyes in shadow, dramatic low angle, thick fog
a grey cat's glowing eyes in darkness among moorland rocks, fog swirling
a toad sitting on a wet stone, throat sac inflated, lit by faint lightning
the third witch half-dissolved into fog, only the side of her face visible, pale white pupil glowing

full page dramatic panel, three fading witch silhouettes dissolving into thick fog, a charred dead tree in the foreground, near-monochrome with a single accent of dark red war banners in the far distance

dialogue.speaker: 三女巫（齊聲）
dialogue.text: 美即是醜，醜即是美——穿過迷霧與濁氣，飄然而去。

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 戰場上，有一個名字正被反覆傳頌……
